title: Unique Number of Occurrences
goal: Decide whether all distinct array values have distinct occurrence counts.
strategy: Count each value first. Then check whether a frequency is claimed by more than one value.

phasePurposes.inspect: Count each value first. Then check whether a frequency is claimed by more than one value.
phasePurposes.update: No two distinct values share the same frequency.
phasePurposes.done: No two distinct values share the same frequency.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
